name: Hawkmoon

perks.name: Arrowhead Brake
perks.desc:
Lightly vented barrel.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Chambered Compensator
perks.desc:
Stable barrel attachment.
  •  Increases stability
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Corkscrew Rifling
perks.desc:
Balanced barrel. 
  •  Slightly increases range and stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

perks.name: Extended Barrel
perks.desc:
Weighty barrel extension.
  •  Increases range
  •  Decreases handling speed
  •  Moderately controls recoil

perks.name: Fluted Barrel
perks.desc:
Ultra-light barrel. 
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Full Bore
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for distance.
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Hammer-Forged Rifling
perks.desc:
Durable ranged barrel.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Polygonal Rifling
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for recoil reduction.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Smallbore
perks.desc:
Dual strength barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Full Choke
perks.desc: Tightened barrel. Reduces projectile spread when aiming down sights at the cost of precision damage.

perks.name: Rifled Barrel
perks.desc:
Ranged shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Greatly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Alloy Magazine
perks.desc: Faster reload when the magazine is nearly empty.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.desc: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Killing Wind
perks.desc: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for a short duration.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.desc: Faster time to aim down sights.

perks.name: Eye of the Storm
perks.desc: This weapon becomes more accurate and boosts handling as your health gets lower.

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.desc: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.desc: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

perks.name: Surplus
perks.desc: Increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.

perks.name: Transformative
perks.desc: Future drops of this weapon will have random rolls.

perks.name: Combat Grip
perks.desc:
This weapon's recoil direction is more vertical.
  •  Greatly controls recoil

perks.name: Heavy Grip
perks.desc:
This grip is weighted for recoil control.
  •  Increases stability
  •  Decreases handling speed

perks.name: Polymer Grip
perks.desc:
This weapon's grip is made of lighter material.
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Smooth Grip
perks.desc:
This weapon is slightly easier to hold and aim.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

perks.name: Textured Grip
perks.desc:
The friction on this weapon's grip is particularly strong.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly decreases stability

notes: Inspired by DMB Podcast 263 conversation with @illPhysics. PvP backup S-Tier roll for duelling. For Hand Cannon connoisseurs - you'll need to keep hitting crits and keep a count of how many stacks you have for the last round in the mag. Seven will delete anything in PvP. Six will one tap anyone not in a super, and five will two tap any resilience. Balance out boosts to Handling, Stability and Range using the barrel and Grip. Then Rangefinder improves both your damage and aim assist dropoffs.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB): "For PvE Surplus or Killing Wind will depend on your build. A higher ability build will appreciate Surplus, a more solo run-n-gun build will appreciate Killing Wind. You could definitely opt for some of the other perks here too as nothing really screams PvE."

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB): "For PvP I really value Rangefinder. It would give it the competitive edge over guns like Thorn or Ace and increase Hawkmoon’s already stellar consistency. If you don’t like the increased Zoom then something like Snapshot Sights really makes Hawkmoon feel snappy. You also can’t go wrong with Eye of the Storm, Opening Shot, or Killing Wind."
